Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: Think hard, and choose with steady mind...

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: Okay, I'm thinking about it.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Okej, myślę o tym.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: Cast thine eyes upon this card!
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Zwróć wzrok swój na tę kartę!
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: There'll be a drawing that looks like a duck [h]or[/h] a rabbit, depending on how you interpret it.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Będzie tam rysunek, który wygląda jak kaczka [h]albo[/h] królik, zależnie jak go zinterpretujesz.

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: What does it say?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Co tam jest napisane?

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: [i]'That's the trick? Sorry, but this is like the most basic optical illusion. There'll be a drawing-'[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: [i]'To jest ta sztuczka? Przepraszam, ale to chyba najbardziej podstawowa iluzja optyczna. Będzie tam rysunek-'[/i]
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: [i]Okay okay[/i], I get it. Very good, well done.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: [i]Okej, okej[/i], rozumiem. Bardzo dobrze, brawo.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: On its back, an image clear - a duck or rabbit's form.

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: My magic act is theatre-born; and played upon a stage.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Mój magiczny występ z teatru się zrodził; i na scenie jest grany.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: So you're an illusionist? What kind of tricks do you do?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Więc jesteś iluzjonistką? Jakie sztuczki robisz?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: Oh? Like with big props? Smoke and mirrors kinda stuff?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: O? Z wielkimi rekwizytami? Coś w stylu dymu i luster?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: Smoke and mirror, crate and cage, dolls and doubles both.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Dym i lustro, skrzynia i klatka, lalki oraz sobowtóry takoż.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: How long have you been doing it?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Jak długo się tym zajmujesz?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en:
Since approximate-[i]twelve.[/i]
I'm now approximate-eighteen.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl:
Od w przybliżeniu-[i]dwunastu.[/i]
Jestem teraz w przybliżeniu-osiemnaście.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: ...approximate?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: ...w przybliżeniu?
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: My sum of years I cannot say. Time hath kept no count.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: Sumy lat swych rzec nie mogę. Czas rachuby nie prowadził.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Symmetry

Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.en: [i]Oh[/i] - okay.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.pl: [i]Aha[/i] - okej.
Conversation/Symmetry 02 YOURSELF/Sectio.speaker: Sally
